@rafikiassumani-msft How does `Accepts` work when Content-Type in Header is null?
I have defined `Accepts("application/json")` as supported content type.

Hi @rachna-lad. It looks like you just commented on a closed PR. The team will most probably miss it. If you'd like to bring something important up to their attention, consider filing a new issue and add enough details to build context.

issue_context.title: Improve Minimal APIs support for request media types & body schema/shape
comments: `Accepts()` should throw if there is a `[FromBody]` param explicit or implicit and it's not just "application/json". We could also look at an analyzer. Unfortunately, I don't think there's a great way to query this at the moment.
@halter73 perhaps it could throw in the builder rather than in `Accepts`, once all the metadata is present?
